senses.gloss: m. (paragauda, παραγώδης of Semitic origin; פרג to divide, cmp. פָּרוֹכֶת)

units: Kel. XXIX, 1 Maim. (R. S. tunic, v. infra).—Esp. (cmp. וִילוֹן) the curtain of heaven.

<cite ref="Chagigah 15a:11">Ḥag. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>כבר שמעתי מאחורי הפ׳ וכ׳</he> I have already heard from behind the Curtain, ‘Return, ye wayward children, all except Aḥer.’ <cite ref="Yoma 77a">Yoma 77ᵃ</cite> Ms. M. (omitted in later editions; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 3).

B. Mets. 59ᵃ שלשה אין הפ׳ ננעל בפניהם there are three wrongs for which the Curtain is never closed (the outcries over them will not be unheeded).—Trnsf. the court, royal attendants. Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod., s. 2 לא דומה שומע מפי פ׳ וכ׳ it is not the same to hear from the lips of attendants as to hear from the lips of the king himself; Yalk. Ex. 276.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> (expl. <he>כתנת הפסים</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 37:23">Gen. XXXVII, 23</cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 3:2">Shek. III, 2</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01484"><he>חָפַת</he></cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Shabbat 120a">Sabb. 120ᵃ</cite> <he>שני פרגוד</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="Q01550"><he>פרגד</he></cite>; Ar. <he>פַּרְגּוֹדִין</he>) two (a pair of) breeches; (Y. ib. XVI, 15ᵈ <cite ref="A00222"><he>אבריקין</he></cite>).
